subject: Technical eval -> PO roadmap and invoice lifecycle
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena@orionbio.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurements@orionbio.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace purchase — next steps and MAP request

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Orion is aligned on moving from evaluation to a formal purchase via the AWS Private Offer. Procurement asked me to capture a short mutual action plan so we can show internal approvers the milestones and billing path. High-level asks from our side:

- A two-week technical soak (isolated workload on your Dedicated infra) with test tokens.
- A pricing commitment and sample invoice structure for private offer billing to our AWS account.
- Legal redline window and a preferred DocuSign route for PO/contract.

Can you share a MAP and a simple invoice example we can attach to the purchase request? Our intended close date is the end of May if legal clears quickly.

Attachments: none

Thanks,
Elena Cruz
Head of Procurement — Orion BioAnalytics
elena@orionbio.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

---
Note: reaching out on behalf of the procurement committee (CC'd).

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
To: Elena Cruz <elena@orionbio.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace purchase — next steps and MAP request

Elena — appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a first-draft MAP (PDF) and a short invoice sample for a Private Offer routed through AWS Marketplace (shows private offer flow + Redwood billing handoff). Key points up front:

- Evaluation window: 2 weeks (we can provision a dedicated test slice in us-west-2 with isolated sample data).
- Legal & Finance cadence: typical SLA is 7 business days for standard SOW + terms; redlines beyond that we flag and run parallel finance intake.
- Billing path: AWS Private Offer -> AWS issues invoice to Orion -> Windsor Accounting (our back-office) reconciles and issues credit memos to your account if required. We include an example invoice (attached).

I recommend the following MAP milestones (dates relative to your confirmation):
1) 2027-05-03: Evaluation kickoff (credentials + test dataset)
2) 2027-05-17: Evaluation close / acceptance sign-off (success criteria met)
3) 2027-05-18: Submit PO via DocuSign link / private offer acceptance
4) 2027-05-21: AWS private-offer activation and first invoice cycle

I attached: "nikhil_map_orion_v1.pdf" (MAP), "orion_po_instructions.pdf" (PO submission steps), and a sample invoice.

A couple of dependencies to call out so your internal approvers have context:
- If you need custom data residency/offboarding clauses we may need a short legal addendum (adds ~3-5 business days).
- If your finance team requires direct Redwood invoicing (instead of AWS passthrough), we'll need to convert to a committed Dedicated contract — that changes cadence and billing entity.

Will loop in Revenue Ops (Laura) to confirm the billing path and DocuSign template. Let me know if the MAP dates are realistic for you and I can lock resources.

Cheers,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com
+1 (510) 555-0342

Attachments: nikil_map_orion_v1.pdf, orion_po_instructions.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Elena Cruz <elena@orionbio.com>, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace purchase — next steps and MAP request

Elena — looping in RevOps to confirm the hands-on billing path and invoice flow. Quick clarifications from our side:

- AWS Private Offer invoice flow: AWS will bill Orion directly. Redwood provides a signed private-offer acceptance which shows the agreed price and SKU mapping. Your AP team can process AWS invoices as usual.
- If you require Redwood to be the invoice issuer, we need a short SOW and a Dedicated capacity purchase (different contracting and a 30-day lead for provisioning).
- Redlines: attached is a redline template we typically accept for commercial teams (redline_template_r1.docx). If you send legal notes by 2027-05-10 we can run an expedited review and still hit your end-of-May close.

Proposed operational checklist (we can convert this to a shared doc):
- Week 0 (confirm): Sign MAP + test user creation
- Week 1-2 (evaluation): Access, tests, daily standups if needed
- Week 2 (acceptance): Formal sign-off form submitted to Procurement
- Week 2+ (procurement): PO submission via DocuSign / AWS private-offer acceptance

I've attached the redline template and will add a HubSpot link with the private-offer doc. Nikhil — if Orion wants a short billing runbook (AP contact names, expected invoice fields) I can export one and attach.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

Attachments: redline_template_r1.docx

From: Elena Cruz <elena@orionbio.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurements@orionbio.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace purchase — next steps and MAP request

Thanks Nikhil & Laura — this is perfect and aligns with our internal timeline. A couple of notes from Procurement:

- We will sign the MAP by 2027-05-02 and kick off the evaluation on 2027-05-03.
- Legal will submit redlines by 2027-05-06 (we will use your template).
- We prefer the AWS-billed route (Orion receives AWS invoices). Please include expected invoice line items (SKU, term, effective date) in the billing runbook — that will speed AP processing.
- Our AP contact: AP Team <ap@orionbio.com>. I'll forward the internal AWS account ID to you privately.

Attachments: procurement_requirements.xlsx (attached by Procurement team — referenced), internal_aws_account.txt

Elena Cruz
Head of Procurement — Orion BioAnalytics

---
Onward: I'll approve the MAP and ping once redlines are in. Looking forward to a smooth close.
body_summary: Mutual action plan and billing path for AWS Private Offer; evaluation dates, legal redline window, and AP invoicing preferences. Attachments exchanged: MAP PDF, invoice sample, redline template, and PO instructions.
